summary_en: 400,000 shares of common stock to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 22,738,000 (treasury: 1,462,582 shares remaining).
title_en: Notice regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-13, CELM Inc. announced a board resolution to cancel 400,000 treasury shares of common stock under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled for 2026-08-31. The 400,000 shares represent 1.7% of issued shares (ex-treasury) prior to the cancellation. Following the cancellation, total issued shares will be 22,738,000, and the company will hold 1,462,582 treasury shares.
